alt-rap.note: CWI house lane — the vetting baseline is calibrated on it

spines.facts: CWI-1 Scoreboard Chip — cite only VERIFIED numbers
spines.rights: Chain-of-Title Compass — every cleared-claim checks a passport first

steps.name: Catalog Depth
steps.protocol: Count the prospect's publicly released tracks on the primary platform (Spotify/Apple/YouTube).
steps.rule: >= 5 released tracks. Below 5, the card files with confidence capped at ESTIMATE and verdict restricted to HOLD or PASS.

steps.name: Release History Consistency
steps.protocol: Check that releases appear over a real timeline (no single-day backfill spikes), artist name spelling is consistent across releases, and the profile is not a dumping ground for re-uploads of one track.
steps.rule: Timeline must be explicable. Consistent artist-name spelling is a CWI catalog rule — the canonical spelling is "King Akeem" and distributor-error drift is a red flag.

steps.name: Label Conflict Scan
steps.protocol: Search the prospect's releases for label/copyright strings. If another label or publisher appears on the catalog, flag CONFLICT until Business Affairs clears it. Compare against the CWI roster: That Boy Hi Hat, King Akeem, Greg Porn, Dre50, 183 Wildboi, Fleekz.
steps.rule: Any active label/P&R conflict on the catalog blocks a SIGN-HOLD verdict.

steps.name: Engagement Sanity
steps.protocol: Compare streaming numbers, monthly listeners, and social followers for internal plausibility. Wild mismatches (e.g. 1M plays, 40 followers, 3 posts) are documented in the card as CLAIM-UNVERIFIED rather than repeated as wins. Never carry an unverified stat into a verdict — the Chip's zero-hype rule applies here too.
steps.rule: Unverifiable engagement stays UNVERIFIED on the card. No unverified number may justify SIGN-HOLD.

steps.name: Rights Red-Flag Scan
steps.protocol: Run the Compass lens: are producers/co-producers/engineers documented? Are there samples of known records? Any beat-seller-lease language on the release metadata? Every missing answer becomes a PENDING field on the card, same as a Compass passport.
steps.rule: Rights questions are PENDING fields, never guessed. A single unanswerable red flag cannot be waived.

verdicts.DEEP-DIVE: ears say yes but one hard gate failed — filed to A&R leadership with the failing gate named
verdicts.SIGN-HOLD: all hard gates green, evidence attached, ready for the room
verdicts.SIGNED: already on the CWI roster — used as the calibration filing that anchors the protocol's ear
